steps.what:
New subcommand `breakglass-otp-probe --email admin@adventure.asia` in tools/identity/workforce_bootstrap.py, following cmd_breakglass_verify at :605 and the USER_AUTH helper at :356.
1. Record Enabled and enable the user.
